items.front: Ocean relief zones from coast to deep, and the deepest?
items.back: Shelf → slope → rise → abyssal plain → trench (deepest, Mariana ~11 km); mid-ocean ridge at divergent edges.
items.examPoint: Ocean relief — continental shelf/slope/rise, abyssal plain, trenches (Mariana), mid-ocean ridges

items.front: Average ocean salinity and why the Dead Sea is so salty?
items.back: ~35‰ (NaCl-dominated). Dead Sea = enclosed, high evaporation, no outlet → extreme salinity.
items.examPoint: Salinity — average 35‰, controlling factors, Dead Sea/Baltic extremes

items.back: The layer where temperature falls rapidly with depth, separating warm surface water from cold deep water.
items.examPoint: Ocean temperature — thermocline, vertical & horizontal variation

items.front: Classify: Gulf Stream, Kuroshio, Humboldt, Benguela.
items.back: Warm: Gulf Stream (N Atlantic), Kuroshio (NW Pacific). Cold: Humboldt (SE Pacific), Benguela (SE Atlantic).
items.examPoint: Ocean currents — warm vs cold; Gulf Stream, Kuroshio, Humboldt, Benguela; effect on climate & fishing

items.back: Spring (highest) at new & full moon (Sun-Earth-Moon aligned); neap (lowest) at 1st & 3rd quarter (right angles).
items.examPoint: Movements of ocean water — waves, tides (spring/neap), causes of tides

items.front: Coral reef types and growth conditions?
items.back: Fringing, barrier (lagoon), atoll (ring). Need warm (>20°C), shallow, clear, sediment-free, normal-salinity water.
items.examPoint: Coral reefs — fringing/barrier/atoll, growth conditions & bleaching

items.back: Nodules = manganese, nickel, copper, cobalt (on abyssal plains). OTEC uses warm-surface vs cold-deep temperature gap.
items.examPoint: Marine resources — fisheries, polymetallic nodules, offshore oil/gas, minerals

items.front: EEZ limit and India's Deep Ocean submersible?
items.back: EEZ = 200 nautical miles (UNCLOS). Samudrayaan sends 3 persons to 6,000 m in MATSYA-6000 (NIOT).

items.front: AP coastline length and 2004 tsunami cause?
items.back: ~974 km, longest on India's east coast. 2004 tsunami = undersea earthquake off Sumatra (Sunda Trench, Mw ~9.1).
items.examPoint: AP coastline (~974 km, longest east coast) — fisheries & ports

items.front: Three characteristic classes of ocean water (syllabus)?
items.back: Physical (temperature, salinity, density), chemical (dissolved O₂/CO₂, salts), biological (plankton, nekton, benthos).
items.examPoint: Physical, chemical & biological characteristics of oceans (syllabus wording)
